findings.statement: As of the end of the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 the company says it was effectively foreclosed from China's data center compute market, although it could ship uncontrolled products such as gaming and workstation GPUs.
findings.rationale: The latest risk-factor language says China is not a market for its data center products, which directly contradicts the claim.

quotes.text: As of the end of the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, while we were able to ship uncontrolled products to China, such as gaming and workstation GPUs, we were effectively foreclosed from competing in China’s data center computing/compute market, and our effective foreclosure from the China market helped our competitors build larger developer and customer ecosystems to challenge us worldwide.

findings.statement: Licences granted in August 2025 for certain H20 products produced approximately $60 million in H20 revenue.
findings.rationale: Licences were granted, but the revenue under them was small in the filing's own terms, which does not show a meaningful market.

quotes.text: In August 2025, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship certain H20 products to certain China-based customers. We generated approximately $60 million in H20 revenue under those licenses.

findings.statement: A February 2026 licence allows small amounts of H200 products to be shipped to specific China-based customers, but no revenue has been generated under it and it is not known whether imports will be allowed into China.
findings.rationale: The approval exists, but the filing reports no revenue from it and uncertainty over import into China.

quotes.text: In February 2026, the USG granted a license that would allow us to ship small amounts of H200 products to specific China-based customers. To date, we have not generated any revenue under the H200 licensing program, and do not yet know whether any imports will be allowed into China.

response.rationale: Licence approvals are described, but the filings report modest H20 revenue, no H200 revenue to date, and an effective foreclosure from China's data center market, so the claim is not supported.
unknowns: China data center revenue in the latest quarter, which the passages do not give.
Whether H200 shipments into China will be permitted.
Whether any later licence or product change alters the foreclosure described as of the second quarter of fiscal year 2027.
